answer: A fake cluster costs real capital, and any attempt to spin up many identities creates a ripple of slashing risk across the network. Sybil resistance can be anchored in stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond on a public terrace of reputation, where history is visible and auditable. Like footprints vanishing on a dune, cheap throwaway accounts leave no durable record, so peers weight votes by bonded history rather than headcount. In practice, sa0014 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
